paragraphs: Chapter 760
Episode 187. The People We Must Find, Unexpected Clue (1)
Caldron Tundra.
As soon as Jin arrived here on the red owl, he felt uneasy. Even if he met Runtia again, unlike Bailam, he couldn't revert her with his current purification ability.
His second sister was likely still enduring a solitary time, turned into a monster enveloped in chaotic madness.
In the midst of an endless snowfield where the spirit energy had disappeared and spread out pure white again, there was a cave leading to Runtia's subspace.
[Myaah...]
As they approached the cave, it seemed as if Shuri was encouraging him by licking Jin's back.
"Shuri, thank you."
"Don't you thank me."
"Ah, yes. I should thank you as well. Veil, start releasing your energy slowly."
As soon as Veil transformed, a golden energy began to overflow inside the cave in no time.

When Jin first came to find Runtia, he had accidentally opened the door to the subspace through Shakan and spiritual energy. But this time, a door formed in the center without consuming any spiritual energy.
He could already feel a dense spirit energy from the door. The evil god and the prophet had met complete annihilation, but the spirit energy used on Runtia had not disappeared.
[It's gloomy... do we really need to go in? You said we don't have a means to revert your sister now.]
"That's not the point now. Follow me quickly."
He sent Shuri back to his crimson jade and moved beyond the door.
A vast subspace was revealed immediately. Since the time in the subspace flowed differently from the human world, he had to check on Runtia quickly and leave.
However, he could not find the path he used last time, even when he tried to recall. Without Valeria's landmarks, the subspace was nothing but empty darkness.
"Veil, you go that way, and I will check this..."
In that instant.
Suddenly, Jin felt the energy of chaos coming from far away. It was fast, as if it was in a hurry.
'Is that Sister Runtia's energy?'
The spirit energy is strong. That meant that there was a high possibility that Runtia was no longer sane.
His heart sank again, but Runtia, who appeared shortly after, quickly washed away Jin's ominous premonition.
[Jin, my youngest!]
"Sister!?"
Surprisingly, Runtia still retained her sanity from when she was human.
-"[If I connect to that, I will go mad again.]"
The words that Runtia said last time.
The 'connection points' that link her and the subspace still existed, and she had horns protruding from her forehead as before.
[Are you surprised that I'm more okay than you thought?]
"It sounds like something a villain would say when you say it like that. I'm surprised, but I'm even happier."
[Hehe, my mind has been coming back bit by bit since a while ago, now it's exactly the same as before. I think it might be thanks to you defeating the evil god.]

Just as she said, Runtia's sanity was a result of the evil god's death. The ownerless spirit energies could no longer erode Runtia's mind. Nonetheless, it was possible because Runtia's will was so remarkable.
"I'm really glad, sister."
[Who's that on the side?]
"His name is Veil, he's a former knight of Runquendel."
[What? It's an honor to meet a great ancestor!]
When Runtia bowed down on one knee in respect, Veil seemed quite satisfied.

[Yeah, yeah. Finally, I meet a descendant who knows their place. This guy only knows how to boss me around, seems like he has no concept of respecting ancestors! As his sister, give him a scolding for once!]
"He's a bit cheeky, but he's a fun friend. I hope you understand, sister."
Jin said as he helped Runtia to stand up.
[Look at this, again, again!]
[Isn't he supposed to respect his ancestor, being a former knight?]
"That's true, but he's an ancestor who we can't say devoted himself solely for the family. We almost died because of him. But now he's getting his act together and is slowly becoming a great knight."
Then he summarized what had happened during her absence to Runtia.
While listening, Runtia did not show much reaction as if she had anticipated most of it, but sometimes she had a bitter expression.
When the story of Diphus' death came up, she shed tears. Unlike the Mu sisters, Lan, and Vugo, Diphus' death was entirely different for Runtia.
[......So, you're saying that you became the Zodiac Beast.]
When the story ended, Runtia gave her respects to Jin this time. She wanted to congratulate her younger brother, since she couldn't attend the inauguration.
[Jin, you've worked hard. I've done nothing while you, our brothers, and people were fighting so desperately. You must have had a heavy burden.]
"Don't say that. Just you regaining consciousness is a great strength. When you return, there will be a lot to do for the family."
Since the last meeting, Jin had felt a deep bond with Runtia. The remaining knights were now truly his family.
"To bring you back, we'll likely need the help of the God-brothers. Please wait a little longer until then."

[You'll manage just fine, but there's much to do, so don't spend too much time trying to save me. Now that my senses are back, I'll consider it a kind of solitary training. Even if you can't get me out of here, I won't blame you. Don't come visit often out of worry. It's unnecessary.]
"I will definitely get you out."
[By the way, my youngest brother.]
"Yes, sister."
[Before you arrived, someone had already been here. I was planning to tell you about it when you came.]
"Something like that happened? Please tell me in detail."

[It happened when I had only half regained my senses, so my memory is vague. They were cloaked head-to-toe, and I couldn't see their face, but their voice was feminine. I had no idea who it could be, but after hearing about recent events... I suspect it might be Lokia Ganesto, the traitor from a thousand years ago.]
Jin also felt the same upon hearing Runtia's words.

This subspace is originally the fifth tomb of Temar. It's a space you cannot enter unless you're a contractor of Soldelet, or have something deeply associated with Runecandle from a thousand years ago.

Even the prophet from the past had to use an object from a thousand years ago to open this place, and Valeria also used Beil's handkerchief she found during her investigation to enter. Jin and Hedo entered through Yeonggi and Shakan.
So, it's highly likely that the person Runtia met was Lokia. If not, it could only be another of the Ten Knights.
[Wait, how was her voice? Was it clear, or somewhat muffled?]
[It was closer to being clear, Sir Beil.]
[Lokia had a slightly rough voice.]
"Someone could easily change their voice. What did they say to you, sister?"
[They proposed a contract to me. They said if I made a contract with them, they would immediately take me out of here and make me the head of Runecandle.]
Runtia had refused that proposal instantly, even in a state where not all madness had subsided.

[After my refusal, they did say some more things... but I can't remember what. From that point, I was too busy suppressing the madness to hear their voice. Damn, if they had found me just a little later, I could've heard everything and informed you.]
"The parts you can't remember might be seen through record magic."
[The Hister that I wounded was a mage?]

"Yes, as soon as Valeria finishes her assigned work, she will come back to examine the records. Even if you didn't hear it, the fact that they said something will definitely be recorded in this space."
Valeria was currently immobilized in the Imperial Plaza, maintaining the Record Window about the Shrine of the Evil God. Jin decided to bring Valeria to find Runtia as soon as her task was finished.
[Oh, I didn't think about that. I told you not to visit too often, but it seems like I'll be seeing you again soon after today.]
It was good that they unexpectedly found clues about Lokiya or someone who was assumed to be her subordinate.
However, there was more concern than relief. The fact that Lokiya quickly resumed her activities as soon as the Evil God disappeared meant that she was hatching another sinister plan.
'If what Sir Padler said is correct, Lokiya Ganesto perfectly executed her schemes that even the human form of Rosa couldn't detect.'
Before her fall, the human form of Rosa was undoubtedly a flawless person, even acknowledged by Jin.
Given that even Rosa didn't know about Lokiya's intervention until the moment she perished as the Evil God, he needed to stay on his guard at all times.
[So, for today, go back, youngest one. I heard that the time in this subspace flows much faster compared to the outside world.]
Runtia emphasized this several times, but he couldn't easily agree, his heart heavy.
There was still one piece of news that he hadn't told Runtia, which made it harder for him.
"Sister."
[It seems you want to talk about nanny Risham. Given your heavy expression...]
Risham, Runtia's nanny, was the one who strongly recommended Padler to replace Runtia as the owner of this subspace. She was once,
No, she still is the most precious mother to Runtia.
From the day Jin first met Runtia in the subspace until now, he had people finding out about Risham and her biological daughter's whereabouts.
[...Risham, is she no longer among the living?]
Risham is dead.
It was revealed that the Evil God directly harmed her.

[Youngest one, I hope you don't hate Risham too much. She's already passed away... she was more precious to me than life itself. Even without Risham's request, I would have been forced to stay here anyway.]
Whether it was then or now, Jin understood Runtia's feelings. Even if he and Gilly were in the same situation, he could never hate Gilly.
[What happened to her daughter and grandchildren?]
"I received news about them the day before yesterday for the first time. They had become refugees during the war, but luckily they survived. They are living in the southern part of the Empire."
[Could you take care of them until I can leave this place?]
Without a second thought, Runtia said.
Jin silently looked into her eyes before promising that he would do so.
